title: The voice in the tunnel
steps: {familiar} is inside the room. The passage carries sounds like a pipe, and the three of you crouch by the mouth.
Someone undid your knots, Rinlo. I know who it was. Their name is {wizard}.
{familiar}, born only today, flattens its ears and runs back through the passage to your feet.
You have one thread left. Tie it to their wand. Their next spell will burst in their hands.
No. You said nobody would get hurt, and they nearly all fell! No. Go away. *(Something is heard breaking, once and again. Then silence. The voice does not answer.)*
Rinlo? We heard you. You told it no. Come down. We'll tell Orla, together with you.
I've broken it. I've broken it to pieces. I can't come out there. Take the pieces away. I don't even want to touch them.
Then {familiar} will bring them. All of them.
